172  def iter_params_for_processing(
  173      invocation_order: cabc.Sequence[Parameter],
  174      declaration_order: cabc.Sequence[Parameter],
  175  ) -> list[Parameter]:
  176      """Returns all declared parameters in the order they should be processed.
  177  
  178      The declared parameters are re-shuffled depending on the order in which
  179      they were invoked, as well as the eagerness of each parameters.
  180  
  181      The invocation order takes precedence over the declaration order. I.e. the
  182      order in which the user provided them to the CLI is respected.
  183  
  184      This behavior and its effect on callback evaluation is detailed at:
  185      https://click.palletsprojects.com/en/stable/advanced/#callback-evaluation-order
  186      """
  187  
  188      def sort_key(item: Parameter) -> tuple[bool, float]:
  189          try:
  190              idx: float = invocation_order.index(item)
  191          except ValueError:
  192              idx = float("inf")
  193  
  194          return not item.is_eager, idx
  195  
  196      return sorted(declaration_order, key=sort_key)
